canonical.title: Day-trips and outings within 30 km of Baiersbronn

parent.title: A Michelin weekend in Baiersbronn — picking the cluster, the table, and what to do around it

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging covering Baiersbronn's starred restaurants
siblings.summary: Baiersbronn's eight Michelin stars sit in three different valleys; no single lodging puts all of them on foot. Tonbach (Hotel Traube Tonbach) wins for stars-per-walk.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Baiersbronn
siblings.summary: Baiersbronn holds two ★★★ restaurants — Schwarzwaldstube and Bareiss — and no ★★ in the current Guide; here is how to choose between them and book.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Baiersbronn
siblings.summary: Inside a strict 30 km circle the only recurring IT event is the IHK Nordschwarzwald 'Innovation Breakfast' AI series in Nagold; for an actual conference, WFCS 2026 in Offenburg (~32 km) and the 112. Datenschutzkonferenz in Bad Herrenalb (~33 km) sit just outside the line.

sources.title: Baiersbronner Genießerpfade
sources.claim: Four certified Genießerpfade, each 11-14 km on natural paths.

sources.title: Baiersbronner Wanderhimmel
sources.claim: 550 km of marked trails including the four Genießerpfade, Seensteig and Murgleiter.

sources.title: Sankenbachsteig on Komoot
sources.claim: 12.7 km, 430 m climb, Sankenbachsee + 40 m sluiced waterfall + Glasmännlehütte.

sources.title: Panoramasteig on Komoot
sources.claim: 14.3 km moderate loop with Mähderbrunnen wine fountain and Sackmann's Panorama-Hütte.

sources.title: Murgleiter
sources.claim: 110 km Murgleiter, 5 stages, all difficult, certified by the Deutsches Wanderinstitut.

sources.title: Tonbachsteig
sources.claim: 14 km, 70% inside the National Park, Oberer Zinken viewpoint, Kleemisse high moor.

sources.title: Schwarzwaldhochstraße — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Germany's oldest themed scenic drive, B500, 60 km Baden-Baden to Freudenstadt.

sources.title: Mummelsee
sources.claim: Largest of seven Black Forest cirque lakes, 3.7 ha, 18 m deep, 1,036 m elevation.

sources.title: Hornisgrinde — Wikipedia
sources.claim: 1,164 m, highest peak in the Northern Black Forest; 23 m tower from 1910.

sources.title: Lotharpfad — Wikipedia
sources.claim: 900 m boardwalk loop opened 2003 through 10 ha of Cyclone Lothar windthrow.

sources.title: Schliffkopfrundweg — Nationalpark Schwarzwald
sources.claim: 3.5 km / 1.5 h circuit through Grinden heath; rare capercaillie and adders.

sources.title: Schliffkopf viewing platform
sources.claim: 1,054 m summit, 360° panorama to the Vosges and Rhine plain.

sources.title: Nationalparkzentrum Ruhestein
sources.claim: Free; 2.5 h exhibit, cinema, Bridge of Wilderness; opened 2021.

sources.title: National Park Center Ruhestein — sbp
sources.claim: Timber-clad pavilions with 36 m cantilevered Bridge of Wilderness.

sources.title: Wilderness Trail
sources.claim: Ranger-led wilderness trail leaving Ruhestein.

sources.title: Freudenstadt — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Founded 1599 by Duke Frederick I; Schickhardt designed it for 11,000 Protestant exiles.

sources.title: Freudenstadt city history
sources.claim: Marktplatz 219x216 m — Germany's largest market square.

sources.title: Freudenstadt Marktplatz
sources.claim: 4.74 ha, arcaded, 50 water fountains in summer.

sources.title: Stadtkirche Freudenstadt
sources.claim: Unusual L-shaped plan with sex-segregated pews facing a common preacher.

sources.title: Panorama-Bad Freudenstadt
sources.claim: 25 m pool, 110 m Black Hole slide, year-round heated outdoor pool, five-sauna landscape.

sources.title: Friedrichsturm closure
sources.claim: 25 m red-sandstone tower from 1899; closed 1 Nov–30 Mar.

sources.title: Murgtalbahn — Wikipedia
sources.claim: 58.2 km railway Rastatt–Freudenstadt, steam service from 20 Nov 1901.

sources.title: Murgtal Dampfzug
sources.claim: Historic steam-train trips Karlsruhe–Baiersbronn with catering and free bike transport.

sources.title: Sommerberg Bad Wildbad
sources.claim: Treetop walk + Wildline cluster on one plateau.

sources.title: Kloster Allerheiligen — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Premonstratensian monastery, charter 1196 by Duchess Uta of Schauenburg.

sources.title: Allerheiligen Wasserfälle
sources.claim: Seven cascades dropping nearly 90 m; gorge path opened 1840, broadened 1842.

sources.title: Restaurant Kloster Allerheiligen
sources.claim: Slow-Food-listed; Mangalitza pork; Demeter-farm produce.

sources.title: Buchkopfturm
sources.claim: 28 m tower at ~900 m, opened April 2015.

sources.title: Kloster Alpirsbach — visitor info
sources.claim: Open Apr–Nov; €8 or €10 with tour; year-round multi-lingual guided tours.

sources.title: Alpirsbach Abbey — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Founded 1095; Romanesque church consecrated 1128, built 1125–1133.

sources.title: Monastery Museum
sources.claim: 'Monks and Scholars' exhibit — 15/16C clothing, homework, drawings, report cards.

sources.title: Kreuzgangkonzerte Alpirsbach
sources.claim: Running in the Gothic cloister courtyard since 1952; 2026: 27 Jun, 11/25 Jul, 1 Aug.

sources.title: Alpirsbacher Klosterbräu tours
sources.claim: Daily 90-min tours at 12:00 and 14:30; combi-ticket €28.40 with monastery.

sources.title: Alpirsbacher Brauwelt
sources.claim: Wedding chapel, beer cellar, distillery, beer-praline confectionery, glass-blower.

sources.title: Baiersbronn → Bad Wildbad
sources.claim: ~38.5 km, ~39 min by road — past the strict 30 km radius.

sources.title: Sommerbergbahn — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Opened 1908; 756 m long, 324 m climb at up to 53% gradient; ~3.5 min.

sources.title: Baumwipfelpfad Schwarzwald
sources.claim: 1,250 m walkway; 40 m tower with 55 m tunnel slide; barrier-free.

sources.title: Baumwipfelpfad — Schwarzwaldportal
sources.claim: 1,250 m, up to 20 m above the canopy, beech/fir/spruce.

sources.title: Wildline — Schwarzwald.de
sources.claim: Opened July 2018; 380 m long; ~60 m above the Enz valley; arched form, two steel cables.

sources.title: Wildline
sources.claim: Daily 9:00–19:30; Heermannsweg 100, Bad Wildbad.

sources.title: Palais Thermal — Wikipedia
sources.claim: 1847 Graf-Eberhard-Bad by Thouret; bathing documented since 1521; restored 1995.

sources.title: Palais Thermal textile-free explainer
sources.claim: Upper floors and saunas textile-free; Tuesdays are designated textile day.

sources.title: Palais Thermal — Thermelust
sources.claim: 12 thermal pools 32–38 °C across 2,000 m² over four levels; Moorish halls with 1.4M mosaics.

sources.title: Enztalradweg on Komoot
sources.claim: 100+ km cycle path, mostly downhill, Enzklösterle → Walheim on the Neckar.

sources.title: Enztalradweg — Bad Wildbad
sources.claim: Bad Wildbad on the Enztalradweg.

sources.title: Bad Wildbad Kurpark
sources.claim: Kurpark + Enzauenpark, 38 acres along the Enz, opened for the 1992 garden show.

sources.title: Naturbad Mitteltal
sources.claim: Biologically treated open-air pool; 2026 season opens 14 May.

sources.title: Naturbad Mitteltal — hours
sources.claim: €5 adult / €3 child / free under 6.

sources.title: Wildgehege Ellbachtal
sources.claim: Red-deer enclosure with adjacent playground in Mitteltal.

sources.title: Wolf- und Bärenpark
sources.claim: Daily 10:00–18:00 Mar–Oct; €14 adult / €12 reduced / €35 family.

sources.title: Wolf- und Bärenpark — STG
sources.claim: 10 rescued brown bears, 3 wolves and lynx on 10 ha; natural playground and explorer trail.

sources.title: Baiersbronn minigolf
sources.claim: Four village courses across Baiersbronn, Obertal, Klosterreichenbach and Schönmünzach.

sources.title: Adventure Golf Freudenstadt
sources.claim: 18-hole course themed on Black Forest landmarks. €10 adult / €8.50 child / €5 under 5.

sources.title: Experimenta Freudenstadt
sources.claim: Five-zone Mitmachmuseum on Air/Water, Waves/Sound, Light/Shadow, Force/Mass, Magnetism.

sources.title: Hauffs Märchen-Museum
sources.claim: Wilhelm-Hauff fairy-tale museum in Klosterreichenbach. Wed/Sat/Sun 14:00–17:00, €1.50.

sources.title: Museum im Stadthaus
sources.claim: Five-level free local-history museum on Black Forest tourism, rafting, mining and forestry.

sources.title: Forellenhof Buhlbach
sources.claim: Trout farm raising ~65,000 fish/year at the edge of the national park.
